notes:
You can now search for several Chromebooks at once. Typing HS0116,HS0189 on Chromebooks → Find / list devices brings up both devices.

The old search sent your whole entry as one asset ID, asset_id:HS0116,HS0189, and no Chromebook has that ID, so nothing came back. GAMbit now splits what you type into separate searches and sends them together. GAM runs each one and combines the results.

What changed:

Where it works: Find / list devices with Asset ID or Search text, and One device → Find by asset ID.
How to separate them: use commas, semicolons or new lines, so you can paste a column from a spreadsheet. Spaces also work when every ID has a number in it, like HS0116 HS0189. An asset ID that really contains a space, like Cart 3, stays in one piece.
Missing IDs are named: when you look up several asset IDs, it lists any that didn’t match.
Serial box: if the serials you type find nothing, GAMbit tries them as asset IDs instead. This now works for lists too, not just one value.
Helper: “find chromebooks with asset HS0116, HS0189” and “disable chromebooks 5CD123ABC, 5CD999XYZ” now cover every device you list. If you mention “asset” or “tag”, it reads the IDs as asset IDs, not serial numbers.
